newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OSCE envoy to travel to Albania on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: OSCE envoy to travel to Albania on Wednesday.

text.p: Europe's top security forum said its envoy Franz Vranitzky would travel to Albania on Wednesday to assess progress in preparing for early elections in June.

"Vranitzky's visit is mainly to look into the question of the way things are going in the organisation of the elections," a spokesman for the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe told Reuters on Tuesday.
The former Austrian chancellor was due to stay in Albania until Friday, he said.
Albanian political parties reached an impasse on Tuesday after a fifth round of talks failed to produce agreement on a voting system for early elections.

The polls are aimed at restoring stability to Europe's poorest country, which slid into anarchy earlier this year after the collapse of get-rich-quick investment schemes robbed thousands of their life savings.
